Description
Experience refined living in this like-new residence located in the prestigious Prime Dunbar neighborhood. Thoughtfully designed by a renowned designer, this elegant home seamlessly combines modern comfort with timeless craftsmanship. Featuring a spacious main and upper-level layout with 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a functional den, radiant in-floor heating, air conditioning, EV charger and a central vacuum system for everyday convenience. Ideally situated near top private and public schools, including Lord Byng Secondary School, St. George's School, and Crofton House School. For Viewing, please complete the viewing form first at https://princesspan.com/tenant-viewing-request.html
